resources.string: Precise location permission is required. Android only shows cell IDs to apps that have it. Enable it in Settings → Apps → Cell Tower Locator → Permissions.
⚠ Location is OFF. Turn it on in Quick Settings. Android hides cell IDs and GPS while it is off.
No connected cell with a full ID is visible.\nCheck: SIM inserted, not in airplane mode, Location ON. Some phones hide the ID while on Wi-Fi calling.
This phone has no compass sensor. Use the bearing in degrees and the map instead.
This cell is not in OpenCelliD yet. Walk or drive around for a few minutes and the app will estimate the tower from your own signal readings. Then tap \"DB / My estimate\".

The free OpenCelliD database gives tower positions. Sign up at opencellid.org, copy your access token (it starts with pk.), and paste it here. Results are cached on your phone to save your daily quota.
